explanation: When one attribute set determines multiple independent sets of values, and those sets combine freely with other attributes, the issue is a multivalued dependency. Higher normal forms are meant to address that kind of redundancy, which is beyond the first three normal forms.

options.text: A key dependency caused by a composite primary key

prompt: A table stores product, store, and approved_vendor. For each product, the approved vendors are independent of the store: a product may be sold in many stores and may have several approved vendors, and every allowed product-vendor pair can occur with every store. If the design still keeps all three facts in one relation, which kind of dependency problem is being modeled?
reviewConcept: Higher normal forms handle dependency types such as multivalued dependencies.

source.title: Normalization and other Data Modeling Methods
